user.title: Pick your mask
user.description: {hint} Make sure the mask is on and the phone app is closed. Entries marked 'non-connectable' are only heard by a proxy that can't connect - enable active connections on that Bluetooth proxy.

manual.title: Enter address
manual.description: Bluetooth address of the mask, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF (find it under Settings > Devices & services > Bluetooth > Advertisement monitor).

abort.no_devices_found: No masks found. Turn the mask on and make sure a Bluetooth adapter or a proxy with active connections is in range.

error.invalid_address: That doesn't look like a Bluetooth address (AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

data.disconnect_after: Disconnect after idle seconds (0 = stay connected)
data.pixel_order: DIY image pixel order (change if uploaded faces look scrambled)
data.max_brightness: Mask brightness at 100% (raw 1-255; slight flicker reported above ~128)
data.blank_slot: DIY slot used for the black 'off' frame

show_image.name: Show built-in image
show_image.description: Show one of the mask's built-in images.

show_animation.name: Show built-in animation
show_animation.description: Play one of the mask's built-in animations.

show_face.name: Show face
show_face.description: Generic: show an image, animation or DIY sequence.

value.name: Value
value.description: Number, or comma list for diy.

temporary.name: Temporary
temporary.description: Don't remember this as the chosen face (used for assistant faces).

hold_music.name: Hold music bars
hold_music.description: Keep the music bars off while this face shows. Default: on for temporary faces, except pack roles idle, sleep and error.

upload_image.name: Upload DIY image
upload_image.description: Upload an image file or a built-in face into a DIY slot.

path.name: Path
path.description: Image file path inside an allowed directory.

builtin.name: Built-in face
builtin.description: Use a generated face instead of a file.

install_default_faces.name: Install default faces
install_default_faces.description: Upload the voice-assistant faces to DIY slots 1-7 (idle, listening, thinking, talk closed, talk open, error, sleep).

set_pack_role.name: Set face pack role
set_pack_role.description: Choose which DIY slots a face-pack role plays (e.g. thinking -> 14). Slots no longer in the pack can be reused by the clock and effects.

role.name: Role
role.description: Assistant state the slots are for.

slots.name: Slots
slots.description: Slot numbers, e.g. 14 or 15-18. Empty removes the role.

reset_mask.name: Reset mask
reset_mask.description: Delete every uploaded DIY image (face pack, effects, clock, default faces), turn off text colours, effects and gestures, clear previews, and show built-in image 1. Built-in images can't be removed.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be on - this can't be undone.

install_effect.name: Install animated effect
install_effect.description: Draw an animated effect (Matrix digital rain), upload its frames to DIY slots and play it. One-time upload, a few seconds per frame.

start_slot.name: First DIY slot
start_slot.description: Leave empty to use the shared slots (1-8, 26-29), which the digit-flip clock re-uploads afterwards. Or pick a first slot; frames go into it and the ones after it (mask stores 1-34).

frames.name: Frames
frames.description: 4-10 (the mask plays at most 10 DIY slots in a row). More frames = smoother loop, longer upload.

generate_dashboard.name: Generate dashboard
generate_dashboard.description: Build tap-to-show thumbnail grids (your DIY faces plus pictures in /config/shining_mask/builtin). Writes dashboard_card.yaml (a card), dashboard_panel_view.yaml (a full panel view) and settings_card.yaml (every setting, in sections) in /config/shining_mask/.

columns.name: Columns
columns.description: Thumbnails per row on the card (the panel view uses double).

restore_selected.name: Restore chosen face
restore_selected.description: Go back to the face a person last chose (dashboard, numbers or actions), ignoring voice-assistant faces.

install_face_pack.name: Install face pack
install_face_pack.description: Upload a folder of frames from /config/assistant_face/<folder> as the assistant's face. File names choose the role (idle, listen, think, talk/speak, error, sleep); plain numbered frames: first = idle, all = talking.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Folder name inside /config/assistant_face (e.g. 1), or a full path.

start_slot.name: First DIY slot
start_slot.description: Frames go into DIY slots starting here (default 10, after the built-in faces).

fit.name: Fit
fit.description: auto keeps pixel art 1:1 (best for frames drawn for the mask); scale shrinks big pictures.

loop_animations.name: Loop all animations
loop_animations.description: Cycle through every built-in animation (the app's loop mode).

rhythm.name: Rhythm / visualiser frames
rhythm.description: Show music-rhythm bars: each frame is 12 levels 0-15; separate frames with ';'.

mode.name: Rhythm effect
mode.description: Bar style: 0 Rainbow, 1 Warm, 2 Cool, 3 Mirror, 4 Vertical.

levels.name: Levels
levels.description: 12 bar heights 0-15 per frame, frames separated by ';'.

stop_rhythm.name: Stop rhythm
stop_rhythm.description: Leave rhythm mode and return to the previous face.

set_gesture.name: Gesture face switch
set_gesture.description: The app's gesture page: switch on/off, library (all, gallery = built-in images, diy) and circulation (order/random). Fields left out keep their current value.

items.name: Faces
items.description: For gallery: built-in image numbers. For diy: DIY slot numbers. Commas and ranges, e.g. 1, 4, 7-9. Any length.

set_music_hold.name: Hold music bars
set_music_hold.description: Pause the music bars while the voice assistant face is shown (the built-in assistant faces do this themselves).

hold.name: Hold
hold.description: On while the assistant is listening/thinking/talking.
